Bitcoin Miner Studio

A local Windows workspace for mining, benchmarking, diagnostics, and Bitcoin education.

Stable release · v2.0.3
Get the softwareRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • Pool profiles with preset previews and validation
  • Authorized ASIC monitoring and Bitcoin Core integration
  • Benchmark lab, diagnostics, and signed-package inspection

Requirements

Windows 10/11 x64 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Python is included in the Windows ZIP.

Getting started

Compare the ZIP hash with SHA256SUMS-Windows.txt. Extract and run BitcoinMinerStudio.exe. Check the protected-file status inside the app. Mining rewards are not guaranteed.

Published release

The download above is the published v2.0.3 release. Later reliability work is not a public release and is not offered here. Check the release notes for the exact package you use.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.
